A '''Low-Light Scope''' was a type of [[Scope/Legends|scope]]. [[Bowcaster/Legends|Bowcasters]], such as the one carried by the [[Wookiee/Legends|Wookiee]] [[Chewbacca/Legends|Chewbacca]], was equipped with a Low-Light Scope.<ref name="EGWT">''[[The Essential Guide to Weapons and Technology]]''</ref>
